description: This file defines the Theme controller class within the Opencart admin module, responsible for managing themes, including listing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, and deleting themes. It interacts with models, views, and other controllers to facilitate theme management in the admin panel.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Controller class for managing themes in the Opencart admin panel, providing functionalities such as listing, editing, enabling, disabling, and deleting themes.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point displaying the theme listing page with navigation, filters, and links to other theme operations.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Loads the theme list view, used internally or via AJAX.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of themes based on filters for display in the admin panel.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a theme, including loading existing theme data and available stylesheets/templates.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Loads the content of a template or extension template file as JSON for editing purposes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing theme, creating or updating theme records.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected themes by setting their status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected themes by setting their status to inactive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected themes from the database.
